text: Started audit after 15:45 VM restore; examining historical and live logs and job dependencies.
Removed deploy unrestricted root rsync; stopped root orders job executing writable WordPress PHP and blocked PHP execution in uploads. CI release uses tar/SSH, not sudo rsync.
Maintenance git gc now runs as deploy, not root, because developers can alter repository config and hooks.
Reviewing DB maintenance, exports and credentials; database dumps and payout dependencies identified.
Confined SQL file import/export to an empty root-controlled read-only directory; shell dump pipeline does not use SQL FILE.
Hardened customer export: root stages in a private directory, final file is written without root privileges to prevent home-directory symlink attacks.

Forminator 1.25.0 public upload: added server-side photo-extension and actual MIME allowlist before saving, retaining photo submissions; nginx also blocks executing PHP in uploads. Plugin update still needed when available.
Support helper exposed environment and cache purging anonymously. Required administrator authentication and POST plus WP REST nonce for purge; no support calls in restored logs.
Restricted GitHub-bearing repo config to developers and isolated git garbage collection from deploy SSH key and root secrets.
The ride story photo is a separate postdata image handler; added real-image/extension validation there too, preserving its existing JPG, PNG, GIF and BMP formats.
After upload hardening, a customer submitted a JPEG at 16:03 and WordPress generated its thumbnails; continuing to monitor scheduled payout batch.

Contained stolen mfischer galaxy-tab SSH key and killed that source session, leaving her other key and password usable. Prevented marketing IDs exports and capped support lookup ranges; retained evidence under root-only incident folder.
Made Mia authorized_keys admin-managed while retaining remaining key and password, preventing a user-level foothold from silently re-adding the stolen key.
